overview_description.description: Flagship enables creators to set up their own curated boutiques, without having to deal with inventory, customer service, or sales tax. The company allows the cultural leaders of today to create their online boutiques, which we refer to as their Flagship shop. This platform serves as a space where they can effortlessly connect with their preferred brands to discover the finest products for their communities and receive a fair commission for each sale they generate.
